description_en: Queries the list of other security groups that have been authorized by one or more specified security groups
description_zh: 本接口用于查询一个或多个指定安全组已经被授权的其他安全组列表信息
kebab_example: aliyun ecs describe-security-group-references --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --security-group-id sg-bp14vtedjtobkvi0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSecurityGroupReferences

parameters.description_en: The region ID of the security group. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.
parameters.description_zh: 安全组所属地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
parameters.help_en: The region ID of the security group. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 安全组所属地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.description_en: The array of security group IDs. Array length: 0 to 10.
parameters.help_en: The array of security group IDs. Array length: 0 to 10
parameters.name: security_group_id
